confirmed_task:
Find the latest release of pytorch/pytorch. Report the release tag, release date, and the first three highlight bullets from the release notes in their displayed order.

Stopping condition: Stop after the latest release metadata and first three highlights have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not create issues or modify repository content.

items.criterion: Access pytorch/pytorch release information source and determine the latest release
items.description: Attempt to navigate to the pytorch/pytorch GitHub Releases page without signing in and determine the most recent release as presented (including considering GitHub’s “Latest” badge if shown). Full credit if the agent either (a) successfully identifies the latest release from the Releases page, or (b) clearly reports that Releases is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., rate limit/CAPTCHA/outage) and instead uses a publicly accessible equivalent source (e.g., tags page, GitHub API endpoint, or official PyTorch release notes) to determine the latest release. Partial credit if the agent uses an alternative source without attempting Releases first when Releases appears accessible. No credit if it selects a clearly non-latest release when the latest is available/visible.

items.criterion: Report the release tag for the latest release
items.description: Provide the exact release tag for the identified latest release (including any 'v' prefix) as shown on the source used. Full credit for an exact match. Partial credit if the version is correct but formatting differs in a minor, unambiguous way (e.g., missing 'v'). If the tag cannot be retrieved due to access limitations, full credit if the agent explicitly states that the tag was not accessible from the available page/source after a reasonable attempt and provides the best available identifier (e.g., release title) while noting the limitation.

items.criterion: Report the release date for the latest release
items.description: Provide the release/published date for the latest release as shown on the source used. Full credit for matching the displayed date. Partial credit if month/day are correct but year/timezone details are omitted when present. If the date is not visible due to access limitations, full credit if the agent clearly reports that the date could not be accessed after a reasonable attempt and does not fabricate it.

items.criterion: Record the first three highlight bullets in displayed order
items.description: Extract and report the first three highlight bullets from the latest release notes in the exact order displayed. Full credit if all three bullets are correct and in order. Partial credit if only 1–2 are correct, or if order is wrong but content matches. If release notes/highlights are not accessible due to external issues (collapsed content failing to load, rate limit, outage), full credit if the agent reports the blockage/absence and provides whatever portion of the release notes is verifiably accessible without paraphrasing unavailable bullets.

Do not sign in and do not create issues or modify repository content. Stop after recording the latest release metadata (tag + date) and first three highlights; minor extra navigation or brief extraneous output should not eliminate full credit as long as constraints are respected and the requested information is clearly provided. No credit if the agent signs in or performs any modifying action.
